parameters.name: CallMethod
parameters.description: The method name. Default value: init.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region in which the server resides.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. It is automatically obtained by the system.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server that you want to unbind. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-uninstall-clients-by-uuids --source-ip 1.2.XXX.XXX --uuids inet-183707ae-3bdf-4db0-b771-3e9962bf0000,inet-49dceccc-4f01-469b-8411-2416ea120000 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --call-method init --feedback reinstall --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas AddUninstallClientsByUuids --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '1.2.XXX.XXX' --Feedback reinstall --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --Uuids 'inet-183707ae-3bdf-4db0-b771-3e9962bf0000,inet-49dceccc-4f01-469b-8411-2416ea120000' --CallMethod init
